comparison.objective: Push rejects off a moving production line at the correct time; candidate commissions an axis damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Time contact with moving objects and redirect them from a conveyor versus small-tool manipulation and iterative adjustment from measured carriage behavior.
comparison.success_condition: Specified rejects removed while acceptable items remain and line hazards are avoided versus two consecutive safe stops within explicit dynamic limits.
comparison.reason: Although both involve dynamic equipment, sorting moving items does not tune or lock an energy absorber.
